newsitem.title: DUBAI: Stocks in Oman edge lower in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Stocks in Oman edge lower in moderate trade.

text.p: Shares on Oman's stock exchange edged slightly lower in the week to Wednesday in steady trading marked by good buying interest for bank stocks, the bourse said.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index closed 0.49 points lower at 183.07 points.
Bank shares accounted for 64 percent of total trading value of 4.38 million rials from 4.15 million rials the week before.
Of the 53 companies traded in the week, shares of 21 fell, 18 rose and 14 were unchanged, it said.
Oman National Holding Co ended the ended the week higher at 3.900 rials from 3.880 rials last week, while Oman International Bank closed at 2.480 from a previous 2.420 rials.
